lines.en: I make my way over to Kirin’s house after she informs me that both her parents and her sister aren’t going to be home for the next several hours.
lines.zh: Kirin 告诉我她父母和姐姐接下来几个小时都不在家，我就去了她家。

lines.en: And while I interpret that as invitation to come over and fuck her brains out on her parents’ bed, I am informed upon arrival that Kirin just wants to “hang out” today.
lines.zh: 虽然我把这话理解成“来我家把她操到脑子短路、就地在她爸妈床上”的邀请，可我到了才知道，Kirin 今天只想“待着”。

lines.en: Yes, I am just as shocked as you are.
But, as it turns out, the vaginal insertion of a foreign object the size of her forearm just isn’t something her tiny body is able to handle every single day of the week. Go figure.
lines.zh: 但事实证明，往阴道里塞一根她小臂那么粗的异物，她那小小的身体并不是一周七天都受得住。想想也是。

lines.en: As such, the two of us sit on her couch and watch crappy reality TV for an hour or two, making idle banter about the people on the television and our thoughts on who they actually are when the cameras aren’t rolling.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩坐在她的沙发上看了一两个小时的烂真人秀，有一搭没一搭地聊电视上那些人，聊摄影机关掉之后他们到底是什么样。

lines.en: It reminds me of us in a way, and how we’re just two more people who change based on who is around us and what we need to be at any given moment.
lines.zh: 这在某种程度上让我想到我们自己——我们也不过是另外两个人，会因为身边是谁、在某一刻需要成为谁而改变。

lines.en: The difference is that I make some semblance of an effort while Kirin goes out of her way to act in contradiction to whatever that may be.
lines.zh: 区别在于，我多少还会努力一下，而 Kirin 则刻意做出与那一切相反的样子。

lines.en: It’s strange being so similar to someone, yet so different when it comes to the ways in which we present ourselves.
lines.zh: 和一个人如此相似，却在呈现自我的方式上如此不同，这感觉很奇妙。

lines.en: Another episode airs and Kirin moves closer to me.
lines.zh: 又播了一集，Kirin 往我这边靠了靠。

lines.en: I don’t know if it’s a conscious decision or one her mind forces upon her to compensate for how alone she feels.
lines.zh: 我不知道这是有意识的决定，还是她的脑子为了补偿她有多孤独而强加给她的。

lines.en: But either way, she ends up beside me.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，她最后还是靠到了我旁边。

lines.en: But never on her sister’s bed.
lines.zh: 但始终没上她姐姐的床。
